> I've always wanted to make a wearable motorized chainsaw head, so this week im going to make a chainsaw man head thats a prop which I can carry around when doing my yoru cosplay. Its going to be motorized and have a spinning chainsaw. Its going to be mostly cad, but the spinning parts are gonna be eva foam.

**0.75h**

So... I just wanna reflect rn cuz man is this tiring like ive spend 4 hours on the front part of the head itself which is kinda wild and i dont think ill be able to motorize the saw right away so i gotta figure that out.. at this point im leaning towards making it the motorized stuff with eva foam. The appeal of having it be wearable has also flown away so im prolly just gonna make a really cool looking prop so therefore i wont need to be concerned with weight and counterbalancing and being blind when i wear it. So yeah imma pivot to that!!
